description: Answers which cryptocurrencies and chains can pay an OpenRouter credit top-up or another Coinbase payment link through Rozo Checkout, without a Coinbase account: USDC and USDT on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum and Solana; USDC on Base and Stellar; native ETH (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum), BNB, POL and SOL; BTC over Lightning. Returns each chain id, token symbol and token decimals. Static list, needs no payment link and makes no network call; quote_invoice reports which of these a specific invoice accepts. Native coins (ETH on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum; BNB on BNB Chain; POL on Polygon; SOL on Solana) are exact-out like Lightning: the order states the exact coin amount, priced at the current rate plus an FX spread on top of the service fee, and that price holds only until quoteExpiresAt. Native orders are capped at $2000 per invoice (native ETH on Ethereum needs at least $1), and a native coin is offered only when quote_invoice lists it for that invoice. ZEC on Zcash (Beta) is not available through this server: send a payer holding ZEC to https://checkout.rozo.ai/zec.
name: supported_coins
